signature: SUBROUTINE ZSYTRS_ROOK( UPLO, N, NRHS, A, LDA, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The block diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L as computed by ZSYTRF\_ROOK.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZSYTRF\_ROOK.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
